name: Release Online Map
description: Schema 9 protocol for the Interviewer release test's offline-readiness journey: a protocol that needs an internet connection, because its map stage loads map tiles online. The journey imports it from a file while offline and checks what Interviewer says and does about it: the protocol's Requires Internet badge, the warning before an offline start, every other stage working offline, and the map's own offline notice.
